build_get_optimizer_param_groups: build optimizer parameter groups from a model, model config, optimizer config, and param schedulers
create_register_param_group_constructor: create a registered parameter group constructor function with a given name in the param group registry
get_param_group_constructor: get a parameter group constructor from the registry by its registered name
get_default_optimizer_param_groups: get default optimizer param groups separating trunk, head, and remaining params with regularization
test_get_optimizer_param_groups: test get_optimizer_param_groups with a model, configs, and schedulers to verify param group construction
